( see jālahatthapāda below ); Th-a II 2, 10 (~-mudutalunadīghaṅgulihatthaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee jālāguṇṭhika-); — °- karaṇḍaka , m. [ cf Jm p. 176, 8 , 15 ], a netted enclosure ; Ja II 104, 18 (tass’ ekadivasaṃ mahānadiyaṃ ~e kīḷantassa); Dhp-a III 199, 14 (seṭṭhī parissayamocanatthaṃ c’ eva pamādena galitānaṃ ābharaṇādīnaṃ rakkhaṇatthaṃ ca ~aṃ parikkhipāpetvā gaṅgāya udakakīḷaṃ kīḷi); — °- kucchi , m. , the inside of a net ; Ja I 427, 18 ; — °- khipanakuminā , m.pl. ( m. ) a “netted” hand (with a network of lines?) ; Ps II 238, 16 (~ehi … udakaṃ gahetvā); Vv-a 315, 30 (~-taṃ mahāpurisalakkhaṇam, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee jālihatthataṃ); — 2. ( mfn. ) with net(s) in hand ; Ja I 234, 19 (kulasahassaṃ ~aṃ … macche pariyesantaṃ); — °- hatthapāda , mfn. , with “netted” hands and feet, prob. with hands and feet marked with a network of lines (one of the 32 marks of a mahāpurisa ) ; D II 17, 23 (ayaṃ hi deva kumāro ~o; cf Sv 446, 21 foll. : na cammena paṭinaddha-aṅgulantaro … mahāpurisassa pana catasso hatthaṅguliyo pañcapādaṅguliyo ekappamāṇā honti … jālalakkhaṇaṃ aññamaññaṃ paṭivijjhitvā tiṭṭhati, ath’ assa hatthapādā kusalena vaḍḍhakinā yojitajālavātapānasadisā honti; Ce, Ee so; Be, Se yava lakkhaṇaṃ); M II 136, 13 (~o kho pana so bhavaṃ Gotamo); — sajāla , mfn. , with lattice-work ; Mp II 238, 19 (dvāravātapānāni … savivarāni ~āni ahesuṃ); — see also antojālagata, antojālī̆kata ( sv anto ), indajālika ( sv inda ).

R:
jālāpeti：ဇာလာပေတိ （ကာ） （√ဇလ်+ဏာပေ）
ညှိထွန်းစေ၏။
ဒီပံ ဇာလာပေတွာ၊ ဆီမီးကို ညှိထွန်းစေ၍။
DOP: 2 jalati pr. 3 sg. [ S. jvalati], burns brightly; blazes; glows ; Dhātup 264 (jala dittiyaṃ); Dhātum 377; D II 264, 22 (~ati su nām’ ajja Vediyako pabbato, Be so; Ce ~ati ssu; Ee wr jalit’ assu; Se ~at’ assu …); M I 487, 11 foll.
